title: Attractor Parameter Record Set (APRS)
description: Versioned, human-readable record of one fractal-darkroom experiment. Structural authority: scripts/validate_aprs.py additionally enforces the cross-field rules draft-07 cannot express (window/caps ordering, RFC 3339 parsing). Decision record: docs/adr/0001-aprs.md.

grammar.description: Operator grammar, identical semantics to brot_build.py.

power.description: z^n exponent (fold/power families carry it too).

window.description: Plot window [x0, x1, y0, y1]; validator additionally requires x1 > x0 and y1 > y0, |v| <= 1e4.

caps.description: Three channel iteration caps; validator additionally requires strict ascending order.

created.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with timezone (validator parses it).

renderer.description: Producing renderer; a compatibility lock, not marketing.

provenance.description: authored-on-site: produced by the playground or brot_build CLI. imported-bundle: the record arrived through an imported bundle.

preview.description: sha1[:8] of the 128px preview PNG, or null if the producer rendered none. Content-identity key for the collection.
